1897, March 20
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK No. 9
Pg. 6 "In the story of man's history, etc." incepi quasi in spiritu coram SS. Sacramento.
Pg. 7 MEANS FOR ACQUIRING THE LOVE OF GOD
I. "Detachment of oneself from earthly affections". Singleness of purpose!
II. "Meditation on the Passion of Jesus Christ."
III. "Uniformity of will with the Divine Will"
IV. "Mental Prayer-meditation & contemplation"
V. "Prayer - "Ask & it shall be given to you" (Matt. VII -7)
"Perfectio," ait S. Bonaventura, "principaliter consistit in charitate, et illa potissimum perfecta est, quando omnis ex- cluditur cupiditas, quae est venenum charitatis. Cupiditatem autem omninoforas mittit qui omnia re et voluntate relinquit Hinc sicut radix omnium malorum est cupiditas, sic radix et principium perfectionis est altissima paupertas."
TO PRESERVE GOD'S PRESENCE
I. Raise your heart to Him by frequent ejaculations
II. Make a good intention at the beginning of each work & frequently during its execution.
